name: Hand counts read the hand of the player the words name, not the open tab's
notes: Found while fixing Ensnaring Bridge (project_bess_base_pt_and_amount_in_subject_2026-10-14). _computeForEachCount read every 'cards in … hand(s)' off Battlefield.gameState, the player whose tab is open. _countCardsInHand (engine-compute.js) now reads each player's own Cards in Hand. Hands: Player 1 two, Player 2 three, Player 3 one. Maro (Player 2's, 'your hand') 3/3. Multani (all players' hands) 6/6. Enemy of Enlightenment (5/5, -1/-1 per card in your opponents' hands) 1/1. Adamaro (the opponent with the most cards in hand) 3/3. Righteous Authority (Player 1's) on Player 3's Grizzly Bears ('its controller's hand') 3/3. Nyxathid (7/7, chosen player's hand) with nobody chosen reads the first opponent, Player 2: 4/4. Memory: project_hand_count_by_player_2026-10-14.
